spec_section_updates.section_4: Cycle 1 QA measurements: EDITOR_MODE count = 0 in react_template.tpl (2588 lines). generate_editor_html = 0 occurrences in render_html_builders.py; generate_html(gen, trip_id=None) is the sole function. All Python files pass py_compile. 21 of 29 ACs pass code-level evidence check. 6 Must-Have ACs fail: AC12/AC23 (no /api/route call anywhere), AC14 (slot-drop has no onClick to apply pendingSelection), AC15 (mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay excludes accommodation from allSlots), AC17 (placed KanbanView/TimelineView cards have no draggable attribute or onDragStart — handleSidebarDrop is unreachable; slot-to-slot 2-mutation batch absent), AC18 (_isCompatible defined at line 1790 but slot-drop onDrop handlers call window.setEditorSelection unconditionally without compatibility check), AC22 (no slot visual state rendering: missing/skipped/late-arrival/required-empty absent). AC21 partially implemented: data-drop-active works; data-drop-reject flash absent.
spec_section_updates.section_6: Root gap: the M1-M29 scope required 29 acceptance criteria; dev delivered 21 fully, 1 partially, and 6 not at all. The 6 failing ACs represent discrete feature subsystems: (1) Route gap/travel time display requires a /api/route XHR call and associated retry UI that does not exist anywhere in react_template.tpl; (2) Two-step tap-to-select requires an onClick on slot-drop elements — only the candidate-side click (pendingSelection setter) was implemented; (3) Live cover image requires accommodation to be included in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay's allSlots loop — it is excluded; (4) Bidirectional drag requires placed Kanban cards to have draggable={true} and onDragStart — they have neither; (5) Slot compatibility enforcement requires _isCompatible to be called inside onDrop — it is defined but never invoked; (6) Slot visual states require conditional rendering code in KanbanView/TimelineView for missing/skipped/late-arrival/required-empty states — none exists.
spec_section_updates.section_7: Next cycle must implement: (1) AC12/AC23: add /api/route POST call after day-switch; render travel_time_minutes in day header; add retry-route button when route status is 'unknown'. (2) AC14: add onClick to each slot-drop element that reads pendingSelection, calls _isCompatible(pendingSelection.slotId, tgtSlotId), and if compatible calls applySelection + clears pendingSelection. (3) AC15: add accommodation to the allSlots loop in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (lines 1745-1782); add cover update: if accommodation slot is newly filled, set day.cover = selectedOption.cover_image. (4) AC17: add draggable={true} and onDragStart handlers to placed meal/activity/accommodation card renders in KanbanView and TimelineView; add 2-mutation batch in handleSidebarDrop for slot-to-slot case. (5) AC18: call _isCompatible(srcSlotId, tgtSlotId) at the top of each slot-drop onDrop handler; if false, preventDefault() and return without calling window.setEditorSelection. (6) AC22: add conditional class/text rendering in KanbanView/TimelineView slot cells for missing (required slot, no selection), skipped (slot explicitly skipped), late-arrival (check-in after 14:00), required-empty (AC24 gating incomplete).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex raised 7 challenges: (1) AC8/AC24 stage source — rejected: effectiveDay.stage from publishedDay is authoritative PLAN_DATA format; editorDay correctly used for slot checks only. (2) AC20 cross-meal copy absent — rejected: applySelection at lines 1879-1907 implements client-side copy via setEditorTripData; Codex misread the code. (3) AC16 accommodation not in allSlots — scoped to AC15 not AC16; AC16 is about reactive re-render mechanism (useMemo + merge), not cover update; gap correctly captured under AC15. (4) AC10 shared resolver — rejected: AC10 is about key-presence semantics via hasOwnProperty; resolver exists at 4 sites; cover/route failures are other ACs' scope. (5) AC21 data-drop-active applied to all drags unconditionally — ACCEPTED: already captured in AC18 analysis; incorporated as note in AC21 warning. (6) AC26 button IDs — MINOR/OBSERVATION: parenthetical in M26 likely descriptive, not mandating HTML id attributes; buttons exist with correct functionality; not blocking. (7) AC4 visual comparison — ACCEPTED: no screenshot performed; elevated to major warning. Codex confirmed FAIL verdict is correct and did not identify any failing ACs beyond those already caught by QA.

qa.overall_assessment: Implementation delivers the core architectural goal (EDITOR_MODE removal, unified page, Python layer consolidation) and 21 of 29 ACs correctly. 6 Must-Have ACs are FAIL: AC12/AC23 (route gaps), AC14 (tap-to-select slot-side click missing), AC15 (live cover image missing), AC17 (placed cards not draggable), AC18 (_isCompatible dead code in drop handlers), AC22 (slot visual states absent). AC21 is partially implemented. Verdict: FAIL.

refined_context.recommended_approach: Address AC18 first (1-line guard per drop handler — unblocks AC21 data-drop-reject). Then AC14 (slot onClick using existing _isCompatible + applySelection). Then AC17 (add draggable to placed cards + slot-to-slot batch). AC12/AC23, AC15, and AC22 are independent and can proceed in parallel.
